description: Plans supply and cost: how long a vial lasts, how many vials a cycle needs, and cost per dose, week and cycle when pricePerVial is given. Counts whole doses and respects how long a mixed vial keeps (from the dataset when a peptide is named).

doseUnit.description: Unit of the dose. BPC-157 is usually dosed in mcg, GLP-1s like semaglutide in mg, HGH in IU.

frequency.description: How often the dose is taken.

peptide.description: Optional peptide name, for its IU factor and mixed-vial shelf life.

pricePerVial.description: Price of one vial in US dollars, for cost answers.

useWithinDays.description: Days a mixed vial may be used. Omit to use the peptide's dataset value.

vialAmount.description: Amount of peptide per vial, e.g. 5 for a 5 mg vial.

vialUnit.description: Unit of the vial amount: mg for nearly every peptide, IU for HGH-type vials.

name: peptide_supply_calculator
title: Supply and cost planner
